name: Antigravity
summary: Google 的 agent 编程工具：查看命令行、桌面版的会话、状态和完整对话；命令行在 tmux 中运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Google's agentic coding tool: view sessions, status and full conversations from the CLI and desktop app; reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when the CLI runs in tmux

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 Antigravity CLI 在 tmux 中运行

desktop.note: 桌面版和 IDE 的会话只能查看

cli.note: 命令行在 Windows 终端里运行时可回复和确认（不用 tmux）

desktop.note: 桌面版和 IDE 的会话只能查看

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 Antigravity CLI 在 tmux 中运行

desktop.note: 桌面版和 IDE 的会话只能查看

limitsNote: Google 账号的 Antigravity 配额只在 Antigravity 中显示（要读它的登录凭证才能查询，所以不接），用 Gemini API Key 按量付费时请在 Google AI Studio 查看。token 按 Antigravity 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: Your Google account's Antigravity quota is only shown inside Antigravity (querying it would require reading its sign-in credentials, so it isn't shown here); with pay-as-you-go Gemini API keys, check Google AI Studio. Tokens are counted from Antigravity's own records
speaker: Antigravity
notes: Windows 上也能从手机回复、确认、回答提问、中断和关闭 Antigravity CLI 的会话（不用 tmux）。
notesEn: On Windows you can now reply, confirm, answer questions, interrupt and close Antigravity CLI sessions from your phone (no tmux needed).

gaps.text: 桌面版和 IDE 只能查看：它们没有对外的操作接口
gaps.textEn: The desktop app and IDE are view-only: they offer no external control interface

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已全部实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (fully tested on Linux)

gaps.text: 桌面版和 IDE 的查看还没在真机上实测（按它们和命令行共用的数据格式做的）
gaps.textEn: Viewing desktop app and IDE sessions hasn't been tested on a real computer yet (built on the data format they share with the CLI)

gaps.text: 没有用 Google 账号登录实测（用 Gemini API Key 测的），登录账号后的界面若有不同，以电脑上为准
gaps.textEn: Not tested signed in with a Google account (tested with a Gemini API key); if the signed-in interface differs, go by what your computer shows
